nodes.en: 12.4 Co-rank function implementation
nodes.zh: 12.4 协秩函数实现

nodes.en: We define the co-rank function as a function that takes the rank (k) of an element in an output array C and information about the two input arrays A and B and returns the co-rank value (i) for the corresponding element in the input array A. The co-rank function has the following signature:
nodes.zh: 我们把协秩函数定义为一个这样的函数：它接受输出数组 C 中某个元素的秩（k）以及关于两个输入数组 A 和 B 的信息，并返回输入数组 A 中相应元素的协秩值（i）。协秩函数的签名如下：

nodes.en: where k is the rank of the C element in question, A is a pointer to the input A array, m is the size of the A array, B is a pointer to the input B array, n is the size of the input B array, and the return value is i, the co-rank of k in A.The caller can then derive the j, the co-rank value of k in B, as k − i.
nodes.zh: 其中 k 是所讨论的 C 元素的秩，A 是指向输入数组 A 的指针，m 是数组 A 的大小，B 是指向输入数组 B 的指针，n 是输入数组 B 的大小，返回值是 i，即 k 在 A 中的协秩。调用方随后可以推导出 j，即 k 在 B 中的协秩值，为 k − i。

nodes.en: Before we study the implementation details of the co-rank function, it is beneficial to first learn about the ways in which a parallel merge function will use it. Such use of the co-rank function is illustrated in 【1】Fig. 12.4【/1】, where we use two threads to perform the merge operation. We assume that thread 0 generates C[0]–C[3] and thread 1 generates C[4]–C[8].
nodes.zh: 在研究协秩函数的实现细节之前，先了解并行归并函数将如何使用它是有益的。协秩函数的这种用法如【1】图 12.4【/1】所示，其中我们用两个线程执行归并操作。我们假设线程 0 生成 C[0]–C[3]，线程 1 生成 C[4]–C[8]。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.4【/1】 Example of co-rank function execution.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.4【/1】 协秩函数执行示例。

nodes.en: Intuitively, each thread calls the co-rank function to derive the beginning positions of the subarrays of A and B that will be merged into the C subarray that is assigned to the thread. For example, thread 1 calls the co-rank function with parameters (4, A, 5, B, 4). The goal of the co-rank function for thread 1 is to identify for its rank value k1=4 the co-rank values i1=3 and j1=1. That is, the subarray starting at C[4] is to be generated by merging the subarrays starting at A[3] and B[1]. Intuitively, we are looking for a total of four elements from A and B that will fill the first four elements of the output array prior to where thread 1 will merge its elements. By visual inspection we see that the choice of i1=3 and j1=1 meets our need. Thread 0 will take A[0]–A[2] and B[0], leaving out A[3] (value 9) and B[1] (value 10), which is where thread 1 will start merging.
nodes.zh: 直观地讲，每个线程调用协秩函数来推导将被归并到分配给该线程的 C 子数组中的 A 和 B 子数组的起始位置。例如，线程 1 以参数 (4, A, 5, B, 4) 调用协秩函数。线程 1 的协秩函数的目标是针对其秩值 k1=4 找出协秩值 i1=3 和 j1=1。也就是说，从 C[4] 开始的子数组将由从 A[3] 和 B[1] 开始的子数组归并生成。直观地讲，我们是在寻找来自 A 和 B 的共四个元素，它们将在线程 1 开始归并其元素之前填充输出数组的前四个元素。通过目视检查，我们看到 i1=3 和 j1=1 的选择满足我们的需求。线程 0 将取 A[0]–A[2] 和 B[0]，留下 A[3]（值 9）和 B[1]（值 10），这正是线程 1 开始归并的位置。

nodes.en: If we changed the value of i1 to 2, we need to set the j1 value to 2 so that we can still have a total of four elements prior to thread 1. However, this means that we would include B[1] whose value is 10 in thread 0’s elements. This value is larger than A[2] (value 8) that would be included in thread 1’s elements. Such a change would make the resulting C array not properly sorted. On the other hand, if we changed the value of i1 to 4, we need to set the j1 value to 0 to keep the total number of elements at 4. However, this would mean that we include A[3] (value 9) in thread 0’s elements, which is larger than B[0] (value 7), which would be incorrectly included in thread 1’s elements. These two examples point to a search algorithm can quickly identify the value.
nodes.zh: 如果我们将 i1 的值改为 2，就需要把 j1 的值设为 2，这样才能在线程 1 之前仍然有共四个元素。但这意味着我们会把值为 10 的 B[1] 包含进线程 0 的元素中。这个值大于本应包含在线程 1 元素中的 A[2]（值 8）。这样的改动会使最终得到的 C 数组无法正确排序。另一方面，如果我们将 i1 的值改为 4，就需要把 j1 的值设为 0，以保持元素总数为 4。但这意味着我们会把 A[3]（值 9）包含进线程 0 的元素中，而 A[3] 大于本应错误地包含在线程 1 元素中的 B[0]（值 7）。这两个例子表明，需要一种能够快速确定该值的搜索算法。

nodes.en: In addition to identifying where its input segments start, thread 1 also needs to identify where they end. For this reason, thread 1 also calls the co-rank function with parameters (9, A, 5, B, 4). From 【1】Fig. 12.4【/1】 we see that the co-rank function should produce co-rank values i2=5 and j2=4. That is, since C[9] is beyond the last element of the C array, all elements of the A and B arrays should have been exhausted if one were trying to generate a C subarray starting at C[9]. In general, the input subarrays to be used by thread t are defined by the co-rank values for thread t and thread t + 1: A[i【2】t【/2】]–A[i【3】t+1【/3】] and B[j【4】t【/4】]–B[j【5】t+1【/5】].
nodes.zh: 除了确定其输入段的起始位置外，线程 1 还需要确定它们的结束位置。为此，线程 1 还以参数 (9, A, 5, B, 4) 调用协秩函数。从【1】图 12.4【/1】中我们看到，协秩函数应当产生协秩值 i2=5 和 j2=4。也就是说，由于 C[9] 超出了 C 数组的最后一个元素，如果有人试图生成一个从 C[9] 开始的 C 子数组，那么 A 和 B 数组的所有元素都应当已被耗尽。一般而言，线程 t 要使用的输入子数组由线程 t 和线程 t + 1 的协秩值界定：A[i【2】t【/2】]–A[i【3】t+1【/3】] 和 B[j【4】t【/4】]–B[j【5】t+1【/5】]。

nodes.en: The co-rank function is essentially a search operation. Since both input arrays are sorted, we can use a binary search or even a higher radix search to achieve a computational complexity of O(log N) for the search. 【1】Fig. 12.5【/1】 shows a co-rank function based on binary search. The co-rank function uses two pairs of marker variables to delineate the range of A array indices and the range of B array indices being considered for the co-rank values. Variables i and j are the candidate co-rank return values that are being considered in the current binary search iteration. Variables i_low and j_low are the smallest possible co-rank values that could be generated by the function. Line 02 initializes i to its largest possible value. If the k value is greater than m, line 02 initializes i to m, since the co-rank i value cannot be larger than the size of the A array. Otherwise, line 02 initializes i to k, since i cannot be larger than k. The co-rank j value is initialized as k − i (line 03). Throughout the execution the co-rank function maintains this important invariant relation. The sum of the i and j variables is always equal to the value of the input variable k (the rank value).
nodes.zh: 协秩函数本质上是一种搜索操作。由于两个输入数组都已排序，我们可以使用二分查找，甚至更高基数的搜索，使搜索的计算复杂度达到 O(log N)。【1】图 12.5【/1】展示了一个基于二分查找的协秩函数。协秩函数使用两对标记变量来界定当前正在为协秩值考虑的 A 数组索引范围和 B 数组索引范围。变量 i 和 j 是当前二分查找迭代中正在考虑的候选协秩返回值。变量 i_low 和 j_low 是函数可能产生的最小协秩值。第 02 行把 i 初始化为其可能的最大值。如果 k 的值大于 m，第 02 行把 i 初始化为 m，因为协秩值 i 不可能大于数组 A 的大小。否则，第 02 行把 i 初始化为 k，因为 i 不可能大于 k。协秩值 j 被初始化为 k − i（第 03 行）。在整个执行过程中，协秩函数保持着这个重要的不变量关系：变量 i 与 j 之和始终等于输入变量 k 的值（秩值）。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.5【/1】 A co-rank function based on binary search.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.5【/1】 一个基于二分查找的协秩函数。

nodes.en: The initialization of the i_low and j_low variables (lines 4 and 5) requires a little more explanation. These variables allow us to limit the scope of the search and make it faster. Functionally, we could set both values to zero and let the rest of the execution elevate them to more accurate values. This makes sense when the k value is smaller than m and n. However, when k is larger than n, we know that the i value cannot be less than k − n. The reason is that the greatest number of C[k] prefix subarray elements that can come from the B array is n. Therefore a minimum of k − n elements must come from A. Therefore the i value can never be smaller than k − n; we may as well set i_low to k − n. Following the same argument, the j_low value cannot be less than k − m, which is the least number of elements of B that must be used in the merge process and thus the lower bound of the final co-rank j value.
nodes.zh: i_low 和 j_low 变量的初始化（第 4 行和第 5 行）需要稍作解释。这两个变量使我们能够限制搜索范围并加快搜索速度。从功能上讲，我们可以把这两个值都设为零，让后续的执行把它们提升为更精确的值。当 k 的值小于 m 和 n 时，这样做是合理的。然而，当 k 大于 n 时，我们知道 i 的值不可能小于 k − n。原因是：C[k] 的前缀子数组元素中，最多有 n 个可以来自数组 B。因此，至少有 k − n 个元素必须来自 A。所以 i 的值永远不会小于 k − n；我们不妨把 i_low 设为 k − n。同理，j_low 的值不能小于 k − m，k − m 是归并过程中必须使用的 B 元素的最少个数，因而也是最终协秩值 j 的下界。

nodes.en: We will use the example in 【1】Fig. 12.6【/1】 to illustrate the operation of the co-rank function in 【2】Fig. 12.5【/2】. The example assumes that three threads are used to merge arrays A and B into C. Each thread is responsible for generating an output subarray of three elements. We will first trace through the binary search steps of the co-rank function for thread 1, which is responsible for generating C[3]–C[5]. The reader should be able to determine that thread 1 calls the co-rank function with parameters (3, A, 5, B, 4).
nodes.zh: 我们将用【1】图 12.6【/1】中的示例来说明【2】图 12.5【/2】中协秩函数的运行过程。该示例假设使用三个线程把数组 A 和 B 归并到 C 中。每个线程负责生成一个包含三个元素的输出子数组。我们首先跟踪线程 1 的协秩函数的二分查找步骤，线程 1 负责生成 C[3]–C[5]。读者应当能够确定，线程 1 以参数 (3, A, 5, B, 4) 调用协秩函数。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.6【/1】 Iteration 0 of the co-rank function operation example for thread 1.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.6【/1】 线程 1 的协秩函数运行示例的第 0 次迭代。

nodes.en: As is shown in 【1】Fig. 12.5【/1】, line 2 of the co-rank function initializes i to 3, which is the k value, since k is smaller than m (value 5) in this example. Also, i_low is set 0. The i and i_low values define the section of A array that is currently being searched to determine the final co-rank i value. Thus only 0, 1, 2, and 3 are being considered for the co-rank i value. Similarly, the j and j_low values are set to 0 and 0.
nodes.zh: 如【1】图 12.5【/1】所示，协秩函数的第 2 行把 i 初始化为 3，即 k 的值，因为本例中 k 小于 m（值 5）。同时，i_low 被设为 0。i 和 i_low 的值界定了当前正在搜索以确定最终协秩 i 值的 A 数组区段。因此，协秩 i 值只考虑 0、1、2 和 3。同样，j 和 j_low 的值被设为 0 和 0。

nodes.en: The main body of the co-rank function is a while-loop (line 08) that iteratively zooms into the final co-rank i and j values. The goal is to find a pair of i and j values that result in A[i-1]≤B[j] and B[j-1]<A[i]. The intuition is that we choose the i and j values so none of the values in the A subarray used for generating the previous output subarray (referred to as the previous A subarray) should be greater than any elements in the B subarray used for generating the current output subarray (referred to as the current B subarray). Note that the largest A element in the previous subarray could be equal to the smallest element in the current B subarray, since the A elements take precedence in placement into the output array whenever a tie occurs between an A element and a B element because of the stability requirement.
nodes.zh: 协秩函数的主体是一个 while 循环（第 08 行），它迭代地逼近最终的协秩 i 和 j 值。目标是找到一对 i 和 j 值，使得 A[i-1]≤B[j] 且 B[j-1]<A[i]。其直觉是：我们选择的 i 和 j 值要保证，用于生成前一个输出子数组的 A 子数组（称为前一个 A 子数组）中的任何值都不大于用于生成当前输出子数组的 B 子数组（称为当前 B 子数组）中的任何元素。注意，前一个子数组中最大的 A 元素可以等于当前 B 子数组中最小的元素，因为根据稳定性要求，当 A 元素与 B 元素之间出现相等情况时，A 元素优先放入输出数组。

nodes.en: In 【1】Fig. 12.5【/1】 the first if-construct in the while-loop (line 09) tests whether the current i value is too high. If so, it will adjust the marker values so that it reduces the search range for i by about half toward the smaller end. This is done by reducing the i value by about half the difference between i and i_low. In 【2】Fig. 12.7【/2】, for iteration 0 of the while-loop, the if-construct finds that the i value (3) is too high, since A[i − 1], whose value is 8, is greater than B[j], whose value is 7. The next few statements proceed to reduce the search range for i by reducing its value by delta=(3 − 0 + 1) 【M3】 1=2 (lines 10 and 13) while keeping the i_low value unchanged. Therefore the i_low and i values for the next iteration will be 0 and 1.
nodes.zh: 在【1】图 12.5【/1】中，while 循环中的第一个 if 结构（第 09 行）测试当前的 i 值是否过高。如果是，它将调整标记变量的值，使 i 的搜索范围向较小的一端缩小约一半。具体做法是：把 i 的值减小约 i 与 i_low 之差的一半。在【2】图 12.7【/2】中，对于 while 循环的第 0 次迭代，if 结构发现 i 的值（3）过高，因为 A[i − 1]（其值为 8）大于 B[j]（其值为 7）。接下来的几条语句通过把 i 的值减小 delta=(3 − 0 + 1) 【M3】 1=2（第 10 行和第 13 行）来缩小 i 的搜索范围，同时保持 i_low 的值不变。因此，下一次迭代的 i_low 和 i 值将是 0 和 1。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.7【/1】 Iteration 1 of the co-rank function operation example for thread 1.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.7【/1】 线程 1 的协秩函数运行示例的第 1 次迭代。

nodes.en: The code also makes the search range for j to be comparable to that of i by shifting it to above the current j location. This adjustment maintains the property that the sum of i and j should be equal to k. The adjustment is done by assigning the current j value to j_low (line 11) and adding the delta value to j (line 12). In our example the j_low and j values for the next iteration will be 0 and 2.
nodes.zh: 代码还把 j 的搜索范围移到当前 j 位置之上，使其与 i 的搜索范围相当。这一调整维持了 i 与 j 之和等于 k 的性质。调整方法是：把当前的 j 值赋给 j_low（第 11 行），并把 delta 值加到 j 上（第 12 行）。在我们的示例中，下一次迭代的 j_low 和 j 值将是 0 和 2。

nodes.en: During iteration 1 of the while-loop, illustrated in 【1】Fig. 12.7【/1】, the i and j values are 1 and 2. The if-construct (line 9) finds the i value to be acceptable since A[i − 1] is A[0] whose value is 1, while B[j] is B[2] whose value is 10, so A[i − 1] is less than B[j]. Thus the condition of the first if-construct fails, and the body of the if-construct is skipped. However, the j value is found to be too high during this iteration, since B[j − 1] is B[1] (line 14), whose value is 10, while A[i] is A[1], whose value is 7. Therefore the second if-construct will adjust the markers for the next iteration so that the search range for j will be reduced by about half toward the lower values. This is done by subtracting delta=(j − j_low + 1) 【M2】 1=1 from j (lines 15 and 18). As a result, the j_low and j values for the next iteration will be 0 and 1. It also makes the next search range for i the same size as that for j but shifts it up by delta locations. This is done by assigning the current i value to i_low (line 16) and adding the delta value to i (line 17). Therefore the i_low and i values for the next iteration will be 1 and 2, respectively.
nodes.zh: 在 while 循环的第 1 次迭代中（如【1】图 12.7【/1】所示），i 和 j 的值是 1 和 2。if 结构（第 9 行）认为 i 值可以接受，因为 A[i − 1] 是 A[0]（其值为 1），而 B[j] 是 B[2]（其值为 10），所以 A[i − 1] 小于 B[j]。因此，第一个 if 结构的条件不成立，其主体被跳过。然而，在这次迭代中，j 值被判定为过高，因为 B[j − 1] 是 B[1]（第 14 行），其值为 10，而 A[i] 是 A[1]，其值为 7。因此，第二个 if 结构将调整下一次迭代的标记，使 j 的搜索范围向较低值方向缩小约一半。具体做法是：从 j 中减去 delta=(j − j_low + 1) 【M2】 1=1（第 15 行和第 18 行）。结果，下一次迭代的 j_low 和 j 值将是 0 和 1。同时，它使 i 的下一次搜索范围与 j 的大小相同，但向上移动 delta 个位置。具体做法是：把当前的 i 值赋给 i_low（第 16 行），并把 delta 值加到 i 上（第 17 行）。因此，下一次迭代的 i_low 和 i 值将分别是 1 和 2。

nodes.en: During iteration 2, illustrated in 【1】Fig. 12.8【/1】, the i and j values are 2 and 1. Both if-constructs (lines 9 and 14) will find both i and j values acceptable. For the first if-construct, A[i − 1] is A[1] (value 7) and B[j] is B[1] (value 10), so the condition A[i − 1]≤B[j] is satisfied. For the second if-construct, B[j − 1] is B[0] (value 7) and A[i] is A[2] (value 8), so the condition B[j − 1]<A[i] is also satisfied. The co-rank function sets a flag to exit the while-loop (lines 20 and 08) and returns the final i value 2 as the co-rank i value (line 23). The caller thread can derive the final co-rank j value as k − i=3 − 2=1. An inspection of 【2】Fig. 12.8【/2】 confirms that co-rank values 2 and 1 indeed identify the correct A and B input subarrays for thread 1.
nodes.zh: 在第 2 次迭代中（如【1】图 12.8【/1】所示），i 和 j 的值是 2 和 1。两个 if 结构（第 9 行和第 14 行）都会认为 i 和 j 的值可以接受。对于第一个 if 结构，A[i − 1] 是 A[1]（值 7），B[j] 是 B[1]（值 10），因此条件 A[i − 1]≤B[j] 得到满足。对于第二个 if 结构，B[j − 1] 是 B[0]（值 7），A[i] 是 A[2]（值 8），因此条件 B[j − 1]<A[i] 也得到满足。协秩函数设置一个标志以退出 while 循环（第 20 行和第 08 行），并返回最终的 i 值 2 作为协秩 i 值（第 23 行）。调用线程可以推导出最终的协秩 j 值，即 k − i=3 − 2=1。检查【2】图 12.8【/2】可以确认，协秩值 2 和 1 确实为线程 1 确定了正确的 A 和 B 输入子数组。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.8【/1】 Iteration 2 of the co-rank function operation example for thread 0.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.8【/1】 线程 0 的协秩函数运行示例的第 2 次迭代。

nodes.en: The reader should repeat the same process for thread 2 as an exercise. Also, note that if the input streams are much longer, the delta values will be reduced by half in each step, so the algorithm is of log【1】2【/1】(N) complexity, where N is the maximum of the two input array sizes.
nodes.zh: 读者可以自行对线程 2 重复同样的过程作为练习。另外请注意，如果输入序列长得多，delta 值每一步都会减半，因此算法的复杂度为 log【1】2【/1】(N)，其中 N 是两个输入数组大小的较大者。

nodes.en: 12.5 A basic parallel merge kernel
nodes.zh: 12.5 基础并行归并核函数

nodes.en: For the rest of this chapter we assume that the input A and B arrays reside in the global memory. We further assume that a kernel is launched to merge the two input arrays to produce an output array C that is also in the global memory. 【1】Fig. 12.9【/1】 shows a basic kernel that is a straightforward implementation of the parallel merge function described in 【2】Section 12.3【/2】.
nodes.zh: 在本章其余部分，我们假设输入数组 A 和 B 位于全局内存中。我们进一步假设启动一个核函数来归并这两个输入数组，生成同样位于全局内存中的输出数组 C。【1】图 12.9【/1】展示了一个基础核函数，它是【2】第 12.3 节【/2】所述并行归并函数的直接实现。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 12.9【/1】 A basic merge kernel.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 12.9【/1】 一个基础归并核函数。
